summary: Milestone 2 frontend testing (MissionForge 2026). Jest physics suite 16/16 pass. UI (Playwright, 1920x1080, graphics low): Earth Observer planner card + Orbiter-9 EO preset, Hangar attitude parts, Readiness 'Attitude control' row + calc + adv-att advisor, Resume Flight from /ck_test.json, attitude panel (all 10 modes, RCS toggle, retrograde slew), Map camera with orbit line + Ap/Pe markers, maneuver planner (apo/peri/now/raise/circ buttons, +/-10, normal/radial inputs, delete), Execute with guidance (align -> burn -> done, warp auto-capped ×10 -> ×1 at ~45 s, Ap 699.7 km), auto 'Before burn' checkpoint + toast, manual checkpoint save/restore/delete, restore of 'Before burn' re-flies the burn to 699.6 km, cinematic camera at liftoff/through staging and fairing jettison, chase/free/map/cinematic switching + C/M keys. No page errors or console errors in any run. All requested features work; only minor UX issues and one spec mismatch found.

ui_bugs.issue: The executed node is not cleared. The panel keeps showing 'Node in -00:07', 'GUIDANCE: DONE · STARTS IN -00:08', and 'After: Ap × Pe 1,250 × 200 km' (it predicts applying the same 141.7 m/s again from the new orbit). The map also keeps drawing a 'Node' marker. Clear sim.node (or mark it executed and hide the prediction) when maneuver.done, and don't show 'starts in' when the phase is done.
The heading is hardcoded to 'Pad 39A — <design>' even for Earth Observer (Vandenberg SLC-4E). The line 'weather GO (not simulated in Milestone 1)' is also out of date.
After the raise burn, the 'Node' and 'Pe' labels are drawn on top of each other and are unreadable ('Nqde').

integration_issues.issue: The review request expects Empty (probe core only) to FAIL attitude and show adv-att. It actually PASSES ('30 N·m vs 0 N·m needed, best 90° turn ≈ 3 s'), which is physically correct for a 120 kg probe core. adv-att does work: I confirmed it with a saved design that has no RCS ring or monoprop tank (Orbiter-9 stack minus rcs_ring/tank_mono), which gives FAIL, the adv-att item, and a working 'Show calculation' link. Update the expectation or the spec.

issues: The Adj -10/-1/-0.1/+0.1/+1/+10 buttons and the node time -60/-10/+10/+60 buttons have no data-testid
After a camera is chosen with the C key, the previously clicked camera button keeps its white focus ring, so two buttons look active
The 'PITCH / HEADING' label wraps onto 2 lines when the values are long

action_items: Clear or hide the maneuver node after maneuver.done: stale 'Node in -00:07', 'STARTS IN -00:08' and an 'After' prediction of 1,250 km; also remove the map Node marker
Use the mission launch site in the launch checklist heading instead of the hardcoded 'Pad 39A'; update the 'Milestone 1' wording
Optional: add data-testids to the maneuver +/- and time-shift buttons
Optional: allow some physics warp (×2–×10) during long guided burns. The cap is ×1 for the whole burn, which will be slow for low-TWR stages
critical_code_review_comments: Flight.jsx restoreCheckpoint builds the sim from ck.design/ck.profile but never updates g.design or g.profile. The list is filtered only by missionId, so restoring a checkpoint made with another design of the same mission makes finish() -> evaluateFlight(sim, g.design, ...) score with the wrong design (cost/payload), and the HUD shows the wrong design name. Either call g.loadDesign(ck.design) or filter by design.

Auto checkpoints are queued inside sim.advance and saved after the frame finishes, so the state can include up to one frame of burn. It is fine at the ×1 cap (I confirmed delivered = 0 on 'Before burn'), but it is fragile if the cap ever changes.

FlightPanels ManeuverPanel useMemo depends on s.t, so nodePrediction runs RK4 propagation every 0.1 s snapshot. That is acceptable now, but propagating to far-future nodes (e.g. apoapsis 45 min ahead with 5 s steps) runs on every snapshot.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all 10 requested feature groups work; 3 minor UI issues, 1 spec mismatch)

seed_data_creation: localStorage only: mf.checkpoints from /ck_test.json; a TEST_noRCS design in mf.designs for the adv-att check (each browser session starts fresh)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fastest path to orbit: fetch('/ck_test.json') -> localStorage mf.checkpoints, mf.settings={graphics:low}, reload, then menu-resume-flight-btn -> checkpoint-restore-test1 (T+07:17, 200.6×198.6 km, i 98.20). Hohmann: camera-map-btn -> node-suggest-raise-btn (141.7 m/s, 700.0×200.1) -> node-execute-btn -> time-warp-10. Warp caps to ×1 about 45 s sim before the burn, so the full flow takes ~80 s real time. Burn is ~2.5 s and ends at Ap ≈ 699.6–699.7 km. The maneuver +/- buttons have no testid; use xpath //input[@data-testid='node-dv-prograde']/following-sibling::button[normalize-space(.)='+10']. The body text always contains 'Separate Stage 1' (next-stage panel), so don't use it to detect staging. Jest: cd /app/frontend && CI=true yarn test --watchAll=false src/sim (16 pass, ~16 s).
